lines.text: Planners say they will go to a city, spend a year, carry on business, and make a profit.
James says life is a mist that vanishes, so they ought to say, "If the Lord is willing."
James calls their boasting evil and says anyone who knows the right thing and does not do it is guilty of sin.
James tells the rich to weep, because thieves have stolen their clothes and their corroded gold and silver will testify against them.
The rich withheld the workers' tools, and James says they condemned and murdered the righteous, who did not resist.
